page.layout: One page of running text, two columns of text in the main block: the main text runs full width at the top, then a narrow column of margin notes runs down the right margin beside the text. Running head at the top centre, page number at top right. Margin notes are in the right margin.

main_text.p: duo Regna Tartarica Cafan & Aftra-can accesserc. Ita imperium Mo-scoviticum usq; ad mare Caspium & Persiæ fines prolatum fuit.
main_text.head: Periodus III.
Canon.
main_text.p: Novam Imperatorum Rus-siæfamiliam Michael Fedrowvitz condidit.7. Imp rantiu muta-tio.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: A. C. 1612, post horrendas illas in Russia confusiones, qvas nebulo qvidam Gregorius Strepium, gerens se pro Demetrio Johannis Basilidis filio, excitaverat, Russi tandem Magnum Ducem crearunt Michaelem Fedrowvitz, qvi Russiæ imperium miserrimè afflictum prudentia, moderatione, ac perpetuâ cum vicinis pace, recreavit, & unam tantum eamq; atrocem cladem à Polonis A. C. 1634 in obsidione urbis Smolenfco accepit. Ei A. C. 1645 fuc-

page.notes: The reading "Russi" in the text is the printed form; Russiæ on the same line appears printed as "Ruffiæ". Possible printing errors: "Cafan" and "Aftracan" printed with a hyphen across the line break. Several letters in the explicit line are uncertain: "Ruffi tandem" with a gap after the first s. The printed "Gregorius" is rendered "Gregorius" in the scan; the Greek-looking form here is uncertain. Margin note at right reads "7. Imp / rantiu / muta- / tio." Woodcut or stain marks not transcribed. The last word "fuc-" is a catchword-like hyphenated break continuing onto the next page.
